blockers.blocker: The frozen v0 boundary is exactly 160 f32 samples per process call and cannot express device-time expansion for r<1.
blockers.reopen: A versioned variable-frame playback actuator or a caller-owned TSM FIFO with source/output timestamps outside v0.
blockers.scope: Slow-down is evidenced only in task-local whole-clip fixtures; the optional C reference covers identity, 1.25x and 1.5x speed-up and caller-clock duration mapping.

blockers.blocker: No target-device pacing, fill/flush, CPU, memory, deadline, availability or service-time measurement was run.
blockers.reopen: Paced workload on the intended target with fill/flush, deadline misses and resource telemetry under the intended profile.
blockers.scope: No device, workload, real-time or power support is claimed; all numbers are deterministic synthetic-fixture observations.

blockers.blocker: No listening test, real speech, real music, intelligibility score, WER model or release-quality assessment was run.
blockers.reopen: Held-out permitted speech, matched controls and authorized listening/intelligibility scoring with rights review.
blockers.scope: Speech-like and music-like stimuli are analytic surrogates; transient and pitch results are deterministic proxies, not audibility or comprehension results.

blockers.blocker: The upstream Signalsmith Stretch library is not vendored, built, licensed-review-verified or benchmarked in this task.
blockers.reopen: Pinned upstream source, license/notice review, versioned integration and independent comparison under the release profile.
blockers.scope: This is a minimal task-local deterministic reference of the caller-clocked adapter semantics, not the MIT library or its measured audio quality.

blockers.blocker: The C provider is unregistered, opt-in and not part of the installed SDK, any descriptor registry or the default build.
blockers.reopen: Explicit provider intake, rights/license review, versioned public-surface decision and independent review before any promotion.
blockers.scope: No public API, ABI, descriptor registry, descriptor default, installed behavior, shared CMakeLists.txt, board or main was changed.

c_boundary_expected.session_rejection_note: Session-level validation rejects malformed frames with AS_INVALID_ARGUMENT. A provider-level AS_INVALID_ARGUMENT is mapped to AS_BACKEND_FAILURE by as_session_process_v0 and leaves the session in NEEDS_RESET; the optional ON consumer test checks this on a throwaway session.
